# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in HASM.

At this time, the project is in an early stage of development and is not accepting external code contributions. The repository is being developed gradually and intentionally by the maintainer, and the current focus is on establishing a stable foundation before broader collaboration is considered.

## Current contribution status

- Pull requests are not being accepted at this time.
- External contributions are intentionally deferred while the project continues to mature.
- The maintainer may reopen contribution opportunities in the future once the project reaches a more stable stage.

## Development status

The project is still evolving and may change significantly as it matures. Please understand that this is a personal, step-by-step development process and that contribution workflows are not yet open to the public.

## Reporting issues

If you are interested in following the project, please monitor the repository and review updates as they are published. Please do not submit pull requests or other code contributions at this stage.
